entry_contract: Continue from 71 Darnassus & The Exodar, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Stormwind City with Ol' Emma or Jeremiah Payson. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from The Exodar to Stormwind City: Take the ship between Auberdine and Valnaar's Berth outside the Exodar; then take the ship between Auberdine and Menethil Harbor. Continue to [G52.37,42.13 Stormwind City]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Stormwind City and meet the first quest giver at [G52.37,42.13 Stormwind City]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
